recognize_zh: CSF 抹片（1a–1b）中可見許多偏心核、細胞質深藍帶空泡、核形不規則甚至多核的非典型漿細胞，部分有明顯核仁；流式（2）顯示 CD138+/CD38+ 族群，細胞質輕鏈 lambda 限制（99.97%）、CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性，確認為單株性漿細胞，符合骨髓瘤侵犯中樞神經。
features: Panels 1a–1b (CSF cytospin): numerous large atypical plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Nuclei are irregular, lobated or binucleate/multinucleate with visible nucleoli (anaplastic/plasmablastic features)
Prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional perinuclear hof
Background of scattered red cells without a significant reactive lymphocytic component
Panel 2 (flow cytometry): CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells with cytoplasmic lambda restriction (kappa 0%, lambda 99.97%)
Aberrant phenotype: CD19 negative, CD56 positive
describe_en: CSF cytospin preparations show numerous large atypical plasma cells with abundant basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm, eccentric irregular to lobated nuclei, occasional binucleation and conspicuous nucleoli, consistent with immature/anaplastic morphology. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD38+/CD138+ plasma cell population with cytoplasmic lambda light chain restriction and an aberrant CD19-negative, CD56-positive phenotype. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by plasma cell myeloma (lambda-restricted, concordant with the known IgA lambda myeloma).

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in CSF (infection, demyelination)
ddx.vs: Reactive CSF plasma cells are small and mature with polytypic kappa/lambda expression and CD19+/CD56−, unlike these atypical lambda-restricted CD19−/CD56+ cells.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma / DLBCL with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; the known history of IgA lambda myeloma with matching light chain and CD56+ phenotype favors myeloma, while PBL is often EBER+ and arises without a preceding myeloma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in CSF
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and lack CD38/CD138 with light chain restriction, whereas these are discohesive plasma cells with monotypic light chain.
Macrophages have grey-blue foamy cytoplasm with folded central nuclei and no perinuclear hof or CD138/cytoplasmic light chain expression.
